ios.desc:
Welcome to the Purr-fect Holiday Countdown!

Create and customize your very own magical advent calendar filled with daily festive surprises! Share the holiday fun with friends and family, and count down to Christmas in style.

Key Features:

• Customize Each Day: Add personalized messages, GIFs, and frames for every day leading up to Christmas.
• Choose Your Design: Pick from a variety of adorable, festive door designs to make your calendar unique.
• Daily Surprises: Enjoy exciting daily reveals that bring festive joy to your holiday season!

Unlock Premium Features with a Subscription:

• Share with Friends & Family: Spread holiday cheer by sharing your personalized calendars.
• Multiple Calendars: Create countdowns for different groups—one for family, one for friends, and more!
• Free Access to Shared Calendars: Join the fun when invited by friends, free of charge!

Whether you’re planning a fun holiday countdown for the kids, a festive office surprise, or a magical Christmas journey for yourself, Purr-fect Holiday Countdown brings all the holiday cheer you need!

Download today and start your magical holiday countdown!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Just Launched Purrfect Advent – A Customizable Advent Calendar App

quotes.text:
Hey HN! I’m excited to announce that Purrfect Advent is now live on iOS! It’s a playful, customizable advent calendar app that’s perfect for adding holiday cheer with personalized messages, images, and GIFs. While it’s cat-themed, you can customize it with any images or GIFs you like!
 • Customizable Content: Fill each day with unique messages, images, or GIFs.
 • Shareable Calendars: Create and share calendars to make the season more interactive.
 • Subscription Features: Multiple calendars are available with a yearly subscription.

Here’s the iOS link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/purrfect-advent/id6473840052

The Google Play version is still in closed beta. If you’re interested, join the group here to download: https://groups.google.com/g/purrfect_advent

I’d love your feedback and thoughts!
